flags.message: context.distribution_count is 2, but the first distribution (Jul 29, for the 9/28 conference) was superseded by a 'Response Requested' entry on Aug 17 before any conference considered the petition; the Sep 30 redistribution for 10/16 is its first real conference. The count therefore overstates true relists by one, which matters for the relist-count cut and the relist-increment claim.
